headline: Fewer and fewer people working are paying for pensions: will the retirement age be raised
summary: Fewer people are working and paying taxes and social contributions, while pension, healthcare and other public system costs keep rising. The article asks whether the retirement age will be raised.
why: Pension funding pressures shape government budgets, public debt and labour-market policy, which matter for bond and sector investors.
